replies.author: Happy-Recording-5291
replies.body: Don’t worry about that. It’s impossible for distributed software. As long as someone has access to the file that’s supposed to be protected, it can always be reversed/dumped/decompiled. For games, the game has to run on the players computer. The only way to protect software now is SaaS/remote software/etc that run on a server with only frontend access given to consumers. It’s impossible for a video game unless a publisher decides that their game will only be playable through some streaming solution like Nvidia’s GeForce NOW, where the game code itself wouldn’t run on the consumers computer. There is no amount of virtualization or “protection” that will stop decompiling or reversing, and it’s only going to get easier for AI to do so.
